title: Beekeeper Go — single-binary Go rewrite of beadkeeper (V2)
description: Reimplement beadkeeper (Python, ~5k LOC, zero runtime deps) as a single static Go binary. Motivation: distribution — ship one binary instead of interpreter+venv+pip. Separate repo theaichimera/beekeeper-go, binary 'bk'. Stays a wrapper around git/bd/ps (no reimplementation, no SQLite driver). Behavioral parity with the Python tool is the bar: output, exit codes, refusal conditions. Full spec: docs/handoff/EPIC.md.
acceptance_criteria: All cli.py subcommands have behavior-equivalent Go implementations; 133-equivalent tests green; diff harness shows zero divergence vs Python; brew install works; bk doctor GREEN on a real repo; no secrets/vendor names in code or history.

title: M0 — Scaffolding & CI
description: Create Go module, cobra skeleton, goreleaser config, GitHub Actions matrix {ubuntu,macos}x{go1.22,1.23}, MIT license, README stub. Binary name 'bk'. CGO_ENABLED=0.
acceptance_criteria: CGO_ENABLED=0 go build yields a runnable binary; 'bk version' works; CI green on both OSes.
close_reason: M0 shipped via PR #1. Commits 3b07f09 (scaffold) + 7f1ca13 (CI cgo fix). CI 26702960651 success on {ubuntu,macos} x {go1.22,1.23} + golangci-lint. https://github.com/theaichimera/beekeeper-go/pull/1

title: M1 — Shared core (git/project/config/filesync/proc)
description: Implement internal/git (os/exec wrapper), internal/project (discovery + daemon/git state), internal/config (TOML+JSON), internal/filesync (cloud root detection), internal/proc (cross-platform ps/PID liveness — HIGHEST RISK, isolate per-OS files with recorded fixtures).
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests for project discovery, git ref/tree helpers, filesync root detection, and proc liveness (stale vs alive PID), validated against fixtures derived from the Python tests.
close_reason: M1 shipped via PR #2. Commit d536076. 33 Go tests green; CI 26703602459 success on {ubuntu,macos} x {go1.22,1.23} + golangci-lint. https://github.com/theaichimera/beekeeper-go/pull/2

title: M2 — Read-only commands
description: doctor, board, sync-branch (detection only), daemon (detection only), identity (scan/dry-run only). No mutation paths yet.
acceptance_criteria: Output and exit codes match the Python tool on a shared fixture corpus; ported tests green.
close_reason: M2 shipped via PR #3. Commits 1e9e414 (read-only suite) + 83f597b (errcheck fix). 30 new Go tests, all CI matrix jobs green. https://github.com/theaichimera/beekeeper-go/pull/3

title: M3 — Mutation + coordination (hard semantics)
description: lease (claim/release/list), merge-slot (acquire/release/critical_section), trunk-sync (scan/apply), identity normalize, install-hooks. Must replicate daemon-live refusal, dirty-tree refusal, idempotency, and id-based divergence/stranding detection exactly.
acceptance_criteria: Faithful ports of test_trunksync, test_syncbranch, test_lease, test_mergeslot (real temp-git-repo fixtures) green.
close_reason: M3 shipped via PR #4. Commits 0878360 (mutation + coordination) + 84c7d32 (revive error-strings fix). CI 26706127615 success on {ubuntu,macos} x {go1.22,1.23} + golangci-lint. https://github.com/theaichimera/beekeeper-go/pull/4

title: M4 — Test parity & behavioral diff harness
description: Port all 133 Python tests to Go table-driven tests. Build a diff harness that runs beadkeeper(py) and bk(go) on an identical fixture repo corpus and asserts identical classification, output shape, and exit codes.
acceptance_criteria: 133-equivalent tests green; diff harness reports zero divergence across the corpus.
close_reason: M4 shipped via PR #5. Commits a58c464 (parity map + harness) + 4616d46 (lint cleanup). 133 Python tests mapped 1:1 to 190 Go tests; diff harness 8/8 fixtures green with ZERO divergence. CI 26715627382 success on {ubuntu,macos} x {go1.22,1.23} + golangci-lint. https://github.com/theaichimera/beekeeper-go/pull/5

title: M5 — Distribution & cutover
description: goreleaser release pipeline; Homebrew tap; README install+usage; Python<->Go interop note (same .beads dir, interchangeable per-invocation).
acceptance_criteria: brew install produces working bk; bk doctor GREEN on a real repo with no host runtime installed; README documents every command.

title: M6 — Close diff-harness parity gap (coordination primitives)
description: M4 harness covers doctor/board/guard/daemon/identity/version only; it does NOT exercise lease, merge-slot, or trunk-sync (highest-risk M3 surface) although PARITY.md sec1 lists them as covered. Unit parity for these is complete (133 1:1); cross-binary parity is not.
acceptance_criteria: Harness extended with parity fixtures for lease (claim/release/list/self-idempotent/conflict), merge-slot (acquire/release/status/conflict), trunk-sync (scan clean/ahead/divergent-refuse + apply dry-run), each asserting JSON deep-equal + exact exit code + refusal keyword-substring. PARITY.md sec1 corrected to match actual coverage. Zero divergence across expanded corpus.
close_reason: M6 shipped via PR #6. Commit 64d16b7. Diff harness extended from 8 to 24 fixtures (16 new across lease/merge-slot/trunk-sync). PARITY.md sec1 corrected. CI 26716337812 success on {ubuntu,macos} x {go1.22,1.23} + golangci-lint. Local harness 24/24 PASS with BEADKEEPER_PY. https://github.com/theaichimera/beekeeper-go/pull/6
